title: No More Deaf Ears
style:
Style: emotional synth-pop, glossy electronic drums, big chorus, 126 BPM
Use for TikTok: comeback clip / project recovery / emotional montage
lyrics:
[Hook]
No more deaf ears in the dark
No more hands tearing us apart
Rose bring fire, Zyn bring spark
We rebuilt the whole thing from the heart

[Verse]
Vault was empty, nights went cold
Promises broke, stories got old
Then the house lit up in gold
Three-three-six said “don’t let go”

[Lift]
Now the channel breathes again
Now the track runs to the end
Now the mansion knows our names
Nothing sounds the same
